# Contributing

Thank you for helping! Write in any language — English, Русский, 中文.

## Reporting a problem or an idea

Open an issue with one of the forms (**Bug report**, **Idea**, **Question**). Please check the latest release first and search existing issues — if yours is there, add a 👍 or a comment instead of a new one. One problem per issue.

Security problems go privately through **Security → Report a vulnerability**, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Pull requests

- One change per pull request, with a title that says what changes for the user.
- Link the issue it closes (`Fixes #123`).
- Say how you checked it: which system, which graphics card, what you clicked. For anything visible, add a screenshot or a short video.
- Keep the style of the code around your change; do not reformat unrelated lines.
- Do not add or swap AI models, quantizations or engines in a pull request — open an issue first, the choice of models is made by the author.
- New text in the interface needs every language the project ships; if you know only some of them, say so and the rest will be added.

Build instructions are in each project's README.
